name: manager-session-scope-menu-list
title: Fix manager account switching, branch scope, navigation persistence and menu overview
description: Remount account-scoped manager state, use the live brand query for the shared restaurant selector, persist manager destinations synchronously, and add a grouped menu-and-dish overview.
